solution:

		<math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>14</mn></mrow></semantics></math>.
